items.gist: The passage lists early ritual subjects such as examining the disciple, arranging places, general nyasa, and preliminary worship and purification.
It continues with topics of scripture excellence, circle worship, sacred substances, fire rites, and related preparatory and concluding rites.
The text enumerates topics assigned to the fifteenth and sixteenth ahnikas, including mandala contemplation, offerings, initiation distinctions, and nyasa.
It lists further topics on thread arrangement, tattva purification, binding destruction, mantra distinctions, and subtle-body practices.
The passage names topics on testing authority, consecration, weighing, and rites concerning death and revival.
It covers hearing, permission, purification, doubt removal, teacher testing, vows, and consecration-related subjects.
The text lists topics on enjoyment and liberation, offerings, eternal worship, linga forms, and varied worship distinctions.
It includes examination of death, yogini gatherings, exposition, guru worship, and initiation and consecration topics.
The passage enumerates mantra nature, power, spatial symbols, qualities, and tattva-related distinctions.
It concludes with the definition of atman as consciousness, the obscuring effect of false knowledge, and the role of qualified gurus.
